arguments.name: targetSelf
documentation: If true, spell will target the current player; Otherwise, targets the player's current target

functions.name: ContainsAnyDisenchantSpell
documentation: Returns true if player knows any Disenchant spells

functions.name: FindSpellBookSlotForSpell
documentation: If found, returns the first slot position of a SpellBookItem matching the specified spell and criteria

arguments.name: includeHidden
documentation: If true, search includes SpellBookItems that are hidden from the SpellBook UI (ex: spells that have been replaced, are also in a Flyout, etc)

arguments.name: includeFlyouts
documentation: If true, search includes Flyout SpellBookItems containing the specified spell

arguments.name: includeFutureSpells
documentation: If true, search includes SpellBookItems for spells that have not yet been learned

arguments.name: includeOffSpec
documentation: If true, search includes SpellBookItems belonging to non-active specializations; If spell is in active and inactive spec, the active spec slot will always be returned

functions.name: GetCurrentLevelSpells
documentation: Returns general, class, and active spec spells that are learned at the specified level

returns.name: skillIndex
documentation: Will be nil if the specified SkillLine could not be found, or if it is not one of the player's tracked skill lines

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemAutoCast
documentation: Returns nothing if item doesn't exist or isn't a spell

returns.name: autoCastAllowed
documentation: True if this spell is allowed to be auto-cast

returns.name: autoCastEnabled
documentation: True if auto-casting this spell is currently enabled (usually by the player)

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemCastCount
documentation: Returns number of times a SpellBookItem can be cast, typically based on availability of things like required reagent items; Always returns 0 if item is not found or is not a spell

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemChargeDuration
documentation: Returns a duration object describing the active recharge time for a spellbook item.

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemCharges
documentation: Returns a table of info about the charges of a charge-accumulating SpellBookItem; May return nil if item is not found or is not charge-based

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemCooldown
documentation: Returns nil if item doesn't exist or if this kind of item doesn't display cooldowns (ex: future or offspec spells)

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemCooldownDuration
documentation: Returns a duration object describing the active cooldown duration for a spellbook item.

returns.name: description
documentation: May be empty if spell's data isn't loaded yet; Listen for SPELL_TEXT_UPDATE event, or use SpellMixin to load asynchronously

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemLevelLearned
documentation: Returns the level the spell is learned at; May return a different value if the player is currently Level Linked with another player; Returns 0 if item is not a Spell

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemLossOfControlCooldownDuration
documentation: Returns a duration object describing the active loss of control cooldown duration for a spellbook item.

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemLossOfControlCooldownInfo
documentation: Returns nil if item doesn't exist or if this kind of item doesn't display cooldowns (ex: future or offspec spells)

returns.name: subName
documentation: May be empty if spell's data isn't loaded yet; Listen for SPELL_TEXT_UPDATE event, or use SpellMixin to load asynchronously

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemPowerCost
documentation: Returns a table containing one or more SpellPowerCostInfos, one for each power type a SpellBookItem costs; May return nil if item is not found or has no resource costs

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemSkillLineIndex
documentation: Get the index of the SkillLine this SpellBookItem is part of

returns.name: skillLineIndex
documentation: Will be nil if the specified SpellBookItem doesn't exist or isn't part of a SkillLine

functions.name: GetSpellBookItemTradeSkillLink
documentation: Returns nil if SpellBookItem is not associated with a trade skill

returns.name: actionID
documentation: Represents a base spellID for spells, flyoutID for flyouts, or petActionID for pet actions

returns.name: spellID
documentation: May be nil if item is not a spell; Will be the overriding spellID if spell is overriden, otherwise will match actionID

functions.name: HasPetSpells
documentation: Returns nothing if player has no pet spells

functions.name: IsAutoAttackSpellBookItem
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem is the player's melee Auto Attack spell

functions.name: IsClassTalentSpellBookItem
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem comes from a Class Talent

functions.name: IsPvPTalentSpellBookItem
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem comes from a PvP Talent

functions.name: IsRangedAutoAttackSpellBookItem
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem is the player's ranged Auto Attack spell (ex: Shoot, Auto Shot, etc)

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemHarmful
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookIem can be cast on hostile targets

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemHelpful
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookIem can be cast on the player or other friendly targets

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemInRange
documentation: Returns true if the current target is within range of the SpellBookIem; False if out of range; Nil if range check was invalid

arguments.name: targetUnit
documentation: Optional specific target; If not supplied, player's current target (if any) will be used

returns.name: inRange
documentation: May be nil if the range check was invalid, ie due to unknown/invalid spell, missing/invalid target, etc

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemLooseFlyoutMember
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem is represented in a Flyout.

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemLowRank
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem is a lower rank of a known higher rank spell.  Returns false if there is only a single rank or it is the highest rank known.

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemOffSpec
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem belongs to a non-active class specialization

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemPassive
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookItem is a passive spell; Will always return false if it is not a spell

functions.name: IsSpellBookItemUsable
documentation: Returns whether the SpellBookIem is currently castable; Typically based on things like learned status, required resources, etc

returns.name: insufficientPower
documentation: True if SpellBookIem is specifically unusable due to insufficient power (ie MANA, RAGE, etc)

functions.name: IsSpellInSpellBook
documentation: Returns true if a spell should be found in the spellbook. This function can also return true for spells that aren't known, such as override spells granted by an aura linked to class talents

functions.name: IsSpellKnown
documentation: Returns true if a player knows a spell. This function can also return true for spells that aren't in the spellbook, such as temporarily-granted abilities

functions.name: IsSpellKnownOrInSpellBook
documentation: Returns true if a spell is considered to be known or present in the spellbook

functions.name: SpellBookItemHasRange
documentation: Returns true if the SpellBookIem has a min and/or max range greater than 0; Will always return false if it is not a spell

payload.name: spellID
documentation: Can be a base spell or an override spell. A nil value indicates that all cooldowns should be updated, rather than just a specific one.

payload.name: baseSpellID
documentation: Will be set to the base spell if the spellID parameter is an override spell.

payload.name: category
documentation: If the spellID parameter is set, the cooldown category of the spell. A nil value indicates the spell does not have a cooldown category.

payload.name: startRecoveryCategory
documentation: If the spellID parameter is set, the cooldown start recovery category of the spell. A nil value indicates the spell does not have a cooldown start recovery category.

payload.name: itemID
documentation: If the itemID parameter is set, it's the itemID associated with the cast of the spell.

payload.name: spellID
documentation: Always refers to the base spell. A nil value indicates that all icons should be updated, rather than just a specific one.

payload.name: spellID
documentation: Can be a base spell or override spell.

payload.name: baseSpellID
documentation: Will be set to the base spell if the spellID parameter is an override spell.

fields.name: actionID
documentation: Represents a base spellID for spells, flyoutID for flyouts, or petActionID for pet actions

fields.name: spellID
documentation: May be nil if item is not a spell; Will be the overriding spellID if spell is overriden, otherwise will match actionID

fields.name: subName
documentation: May be empty if flyout, or if spell's data isn't loaded yet; Listen for SPELL_TEXT_UPDATE event, or use SpellMixin to load asynchronously

fields.name: isPassive
documentation: True if the item is a passive spell; Will always be false if it is not a spell

fields.name: isOffSpec
documentation: True if the item belongs to a non-active specialization

fields.name: skillLineIndex
documentation: Index of the SkillLine this SpellBookItem is part of; Nil this SpellBookItem isn't part of a SkillLine

fields.name: itemIndexOffset
documentation: This value + 1 is the first Spell Book Item slotIndex within this skill line

fields.name: specID
documentation: Will be nil if this skill line is not associated with a specialization

fields.name: offSpecID
documentation: Will be nil if this skill line is not associated with a non-active specialization
